Name: Really Short Grass
Author: SyntheticHeart
Description:
Content pack for the "More Grass" mod, this adds a basic very short grass! you can mix it with other "more grass" content packs.

It DOES make the grass look 'patchy' because it's so short, but i primarily made this pack because I play with extra animals like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21538]CP - Quails for Sharkles[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21031]Slumberwood's Rats[/url] but i can't see the lil beans through the grass... even full size chickens disappear into some grasses!

Right now it's just a simple edit of the example grass pack from more grass, [s]i may add more variations and recolours like for starblue valley (which i do use myself).[/s] Now including a starblue valley recolour! <3

When using the meadow farm (pictured in the fall and winter screenshots) the blue grass isn't replaced so it still looks tall, it'll require a mod update from More Grass before i'm able to edit that i believe.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]more grass[/url]!
